name: Mini Tether
description: Mini Tether (USD) is an ERC-20 token on Ethereum with 6 decimals and 100,000,000 initial supply. The owner can mint additional supply. Its official pool is a single-sided MUSDT/USDT Uniswap V3 position: buys work normally and sells settle at dust value, without any transfer gate or blacklist in the contract.
